title: Perplexity citations get their sources
summary:
Perplexity citations now have sources to point to, while reasoning routes, error responses, and the news lists got tidied up.

Plain-text `/text` responses now append a numbered Sources list when a model returns citations, giving Perplexity citation markers URLs to point to.

The `perplexity-reasoning` alias now routes to `sonar-reasoning-pro`, which is also accepted as an alias. Unrecognized model response formats now return an error instead of fallback text presented as a successful response.

The highlights and README Latest News lists were updated with entries about Gemini tools, `Qwen3-Coder-30B`, standalone `flux`, and SPAN 2x upscaling. These PRs changed the news lists, not the underlying features.
